scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev --workspace @hawelly/api" "npm run dev --workspace @hawelly/web"
scripts.lint: eslint apps/api/src apps/api/scripts apps/web/app apps/web/components apps/web/lib --max-warnings=0
scripts.release:pm2:api:start: node scripts/release/withEnv.mjs --env apps/api/.env -- node node_modules/pm2/bin/pm2 start ecosystem.config.cjs --only hawelly-api --update-env
scripts.release:pm2:api:restart: node scripts/release/withEnv.mjs --env apps/api/.env -- node node_modules/pm2/bin/pm2 restart hawelly-api --update-env
scripts.release:pm2:web:start: node scripts/release/withEnv.mjs --env apps/web/.env -- node node_modules/pm2/bin/pm2 start ecosystem.config.cjs --only hawelly-web --update-env
scripts.release:pm2:web:restart: node scripts/release/withEnv.mjs --env apps/web/.env -- node node_modules/pm2/bin/pm2 restart hawelly-web --update-env
scripts.check: npm run db:validate && npm run db:generate && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run release:tools:test && npm run build && npm run security:client-boundary
